responsibility: Implements the GIMPLE optimization pass for Intel MPX/Pointer Bounds Checker instrumentation after bounds-check code has been inserted. It analyzes check statements and bounds-producing operations in SSA/CFG form, models checked addresses as simple polynomial expressions, gathers per-basic-block check information, removes redundant intersections and provably constant or duplicate lower/upper bound checks, optimizes selected instrumented string-function calls, and moves bounds creation closer to dominating uses to shorten live ranges; it is the post-instrumentation cleanup pass registered as "chkpopt" and relies on tree-chkp/ipa-chkp helpers and target CHKP builtins.
